triage.desk_query: Term sheet G04 states "Coupon Memory Applicable", indicating that unpaid coupons accrue and are recoverable at a later observation date. The booking record carries coupon_memory = False, which would pay only coupons observed in-period with no catch-up. Please confirm the memory feature applies as documented and authorise correction of coupon_memory to True, or advise the basis on which the booking was flagged False.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on an unambiguous, explicit term sheet designation of the memory feature, so the booking flag is the likely error.
